text:
nina.k: Quick follow-up from support: the onboarding sampleapp treats all 401/403 the same and surfaces "Authorization error". Users hit this when their refresh token expired and then have no clear next step. Can we make SDK errors actionable and consistent across languages?

ashley: Yes. We need three things: (1) stable machine codes (dot.namespace), (2) a short user-safe message to show in the UI, and (3) an intent/action enum so the app knows whether to show a 'Reconnect' CTA, reopen oauth, or backoff.

chris.l: I'm proposing this minimal canonical payload on the HTTP response: error_code, user_message, intent, retry_after (optional), and an internal_hint (for logs only). Example codes: auth.token_expired, auth.bad_credentials, auth.missing_scope, rate.limit_exceeded, service.degraded.

nina.k: Good. Sample mapping suggestion for runtime: if 401 && body.code=="token_expired" => AuthTokenExpired(error_code="auth.token_expired", user_message="Session expired. Reconnect to continue.", intent="reauth"); if 401 && body.code=="invalid" => AuthInvalid(...intent="fatal"); 429 => RateLimit(...intent="backoff", retry_after=header.Retry-After)

ashley: SDK parity notes: JS/TS and Python should throw typed exceptions with fields {code, intent, user_message, retry_after, internal_hint}. Go should return typed error values implementing Code() and Intent() methods and helper funcs IsRetryable().

chris.l: UX rule: user_message must be <=140 chars, no internal ids, and safe for end users. internal_hint may include a short diagnostic like "refresh_token expired at 2026-03-20T..." for logs only.

nina.k: Sampleapp change: if intent=="reauth" show "Reconnect" button and prefill an explanation from user_message; if intent=="request_scope" open the permission flow; if intent=="backoff" show countdown using retry_after. This should cut support tickets.

dev-bot: summary: Proposed codes: auth.token_expired, auth.invalid_credentials, auth.missing_scope, rate.limit_exceeded, service.degraded. Response fields: error_code, user_message, intent, retry_after, internal_hint. Action items: RFC for API payload, SDK parity PRs, sampleapp update + parity tests.

ashley: I'll draft the RFC and a tiny test harness that mocks 401/403/429 across JS/Py/Go and asserts both typed surface and raw fields. Will link when ready.
